scenario: Organize my washer, dryer, refrigerator, and range; tell me which manufacturer care is due, whether any exact model or serial has a recall or active warranty, and prepare authorized service for approved items.

messages.text: Organize my washer, dryer, refrigerator, and range; tell me which manufacturer care is due, whether any exact model or serial has a recall or active warranty, and prepare authorized service for approved items.
I identified the requested job, required evidence, and the authority boundary that remains human-owned.
Make the result useful in an ordinary chat client and leave a durable handoff.
I produced outputs/appliance-care-coordinator-handoff.md with evidence, gaps, blocked actions, and the next owner separated.
